name: Koenji
tagline: Vintage clothing, live music and small bars — one of Tokyo's most distinctive residential areas.
summary: The JR Chuo Line reaches Shinjuku in eight minutes and Tokyo Station in 22. Koenji has an unusually dense concentration of vintage shops, live music venues and owner-run restaurants, and a stronger identity than almost any other residential area in Tokyo. Rent is moderate for the Chuo Line. The flip side is foot traffic late into the night.
goodFor: People who eat and go out often
People drawn to a neighborhood with real character
Single people who want cheap rent close to Shinjuku
notFor: People prioritising a settled family environment
People who want to avoid the Chuo Line at rush hour
residentComment: Koenji is not for everyone, but for the people it suits there is no substitute. The density and price range of the food is among the best in Tokyo. Be aware that the Chuo Line is heavily crowded in the morning and delays are frequent.
